review_type: Repository-owner-commissioned AI-assisted Econometrica numerical-methods advisory review
recommendation: Return without substantive review; equivalently, reject in the present incomplete form. The pinned R43 object is not an atomic, reconstructible paper revision. A complete immutable R43 submission may be reviewed afresh.

reviewed_snapshot.commit_message: revision(r43): publish tested manuscript and science source capsule (3/5)

r42_context.r43_protocol_base_statement: R43 is based on the R42 review and preserves all 150 R42 services, failures and clocks.

positive_findings: The frozen protocol preserves the original R42 success counts and forbids retraining or changes to primitives in the diagnostic continuation.
The additional verification is explicitly labelled post-review rather than independently preregistered.
The planned coupled comparison targets direct neural-minus-ridge policy cost rather than subtracting separate regret bounds.
The protocol uses paired innovations, interval arithmetic, familywise error allocation and explicit limits on equivalence or superiority claims.
The intended release plan preserves adverse inherited evidence and separates clocks measured in different environments.
blocking_findings: The five-part R43 source capsule stops at part 3/5 and cannot be reconstructed.
The authoritative root article, supplement and README still point to R41.
No materialized R43 article, supplement, response, result tables, audits or PDFs exist in the pinned tree.
No R43 workflow run or executed evidence package is available at the pinned snapshot.
The branch is a mutable non-atomic staging object rather than a journal submission snapshot.
Post-review diagnostics cannot retroactively change R42 capped-service success counts.
The proposed paired simulation needs a complete theorem and implementation audit before its intervals can be assessed.
Twenty-four frozen state comparisons do not establish method-level training reliability or a task-distribution result.
Finer tensor-cover verification is not evidence of nonlinear dimensional scaling.
The visible protocol does not resolve the remaining R42 findings on conventional baselines, adaptive precision, scaling, scope and substantive economic contribution.

limitations: The missing source parts prevent reconstruction of the intended R43 archive.
No unseen R43 theorem, computation, table or prose is evaluated or inferred.
The companion replay script was not executed in the local container because outbound GitHub access is unavailable; equivalent checks were performed through the authenticated GitHub connector.
This procedural recommendation is not a judgment that the unseen intended R43 mathematics or computations are incorrect.
This advisory review is not an Econometric Society editorial decision.
